text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! It's time for another Cool Cat's
Den! ♪
Is everyone ready to catch some
disco fever?

text_block_list.name: Cool Cat in Training
text_block_list.text:
I-in this segment, our extra-cool viewers
send in their worries, and we'll solve
them lickety-split!
Our first guest today
is this hip and hoppin' gal!

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I'm just passing by. Please call me
M.

text_block_list.name: Cool Cat in Training
text_block_list.text:
Um... Aren't you McQueen? What could
you be
worried—

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text: It's M, for one. And as for my worries, well... I simply cannot resist a delicious dessert!

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text:
A Meji—er, an Umamusume from an
esteemed
family must always maintain
peak physical
condition. However...

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, I give in to temptation and my body weight increases by a small—and I mean a miniscule—amount!

text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm picking up what you're putting
down!
What you need is some nata de
coco!

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
Nata de coco is made up of ninety-nine
percent water and one percent fiber! It's
a light, sweet
treat that's totally healthy
and low on calories! ♪

text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
It helps burn fat and detoxes your body,
so it's
great for those times you wanna
cut back!

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text:
Can I really believe such a miraculous
food
actually exists?

text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can! And don't hold back
either. I
won't have you getting all
sicky-icky on us...

text_block_list.name: Passerby M
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you, Swanky Girl!

text_block_list.name: Cool Cat in Training
text_block_list.text:
What a super cool solution to a sticky
sweet
situation! For our next guest, we
have...

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
Heya! I'm Incognito Idol F! ♪ And my
running
style of choice is front running!

text_block_list.name: Cool Cat in Training
text_block_list.text:
So, Falc—I mean, F... What's on your
mind?

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text: Well, Falco can't make up her mind about the choreography for her new single. What we have is okay, but it's missing something...

text_block_list.name: Cool Cat in Training
text_block_list.text: (She's making her identity so obvious...)

text_block_list.name: Cool Cat in Training
text_block_list.text: Um... Swanky Girl! Give us some tips!

text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
I got it... You want to shake things up,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Swanky Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you the trendiest dance, fresh
off the disco floor! A bit of my swanky
flair and you'll
have a super-cool
routine! ♪

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's so retro but so fresh at the
same
time—how unique! ♪

text_block_list.name: Incognito Idol F
text_block_list.text:
Oh! This new single is a cheer song... so
maybe waving around something like
this fan-shaped
pom-pom would be
good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Great job today. You were amazing yet
again,
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to start eating nata de coco
and disco
dancing too. Hopefully that'll
make me an even
cooler cat! Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You're so sweet to think that, Chiyo.
Sweet as
panna cotta, but naive all the
same!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To be hip and with it, nata de coco and
disco dancing alone won't do... There's
padded shoulders, the preppy sweater
around your neck, plus so many other
things!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll be your guide! ♪ So strap in—a
wonderful,
bubbly world awaits!
